exclusion_reason: Implemented but red because the mounted-image path is not built: there is no ISO/CUE sector read that hash-matches a source image, no in-sync CD digital-audio track, and DRM-protected images are still refused by identity — so no image is actually mounted behind the optical letter. The virtual drive geometry exists generically in lib/hle.mjs: a declared fixed C: (DRIVE_FIXED, NTFS) and read-only optical D: (DRIVE_CDROM, CDFS, zero free bytes) served through GetLogicalDrives, GetDriveTypeA/W, GetVolumeInformationA/W (label, serial, filesystem name, read-only flags), GetDiskFreeSpaceExA, and GetDiskFreeSpaceA over one host-neutral capacity profile.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the mounted image serves hash-matching sector read and in-sync disc audio, refusing protected image.
expected_failing_assertion: No image is mounted behind the optical letter, so a hash-matching sector read and in-sync disc audio cannot be served.
active_gate_evidence: The conformance suite carries a case for every served drive-geometry export (served kernel32 surface 130 to 137), and a dedicated test proves GetLogicalDrives reports C: and D:, GetDriveType returns DRIVE_FIXED/DRIVE_CDROM/DRIVE_NO_ROOT_DIR, the optical volume label and serial round-trip, and the read-only optical volume reports zero free bytes. The extractor keeps refusing protected and encrypted input by identity, and the full suite stays green.
procedure: Verify sector hash and disc-audio sync against the reference.
Attempt a protected image and assert refusal.
pass_criterion: Disc audio is in sync and protected image is refused.
